headline: Approved eight grants, including $100,000 for a K-8 STEM coordinator and $64,000 for medical assisting staffing; approved first reading of Policy ACL.
summary: The meeting included reports from the superintendent, the Gloucester Education Foundation, and the assistant superintendent on professional development. The board approved the consent agenda, the first reading of Policy ACL, which covers interacting with law enforcement officers engaged in civil law enforcement, and eight grants.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda unanimously, including the September 9, 2026 meeting minutes, warrants, transfers, donation, and gifts.
Approved the first reading of Policy ACL, Interacting with Law Enforcement Officers Engaged in Civil Law Enforcement (Protect Act), unanimously, and waived the second reading.
Approved seven GEF grants listed under Acceptance of Grants (items 1 through 7), unanimously.
Approved the FY27 FC709 MA Fresh Corp grant of $6,750, unanimously.

decision_evidence.quote: On a motion by Ms. Prince, seconded by Ms. Wiessen, it was unanimously VOTED: To approve the consent agenda as noted above.

On a motion by Ms. Wiessen seconded by Ms. Liacos, it was unanimously VOTED: To approve the first reading of Policy ACL - Interacting with Law Enforcement Officers Engaged in Civil Law Enforcement (Protect Act), as presented and waive the second reading.
D. Acceptance of Grants ... On a motion by Chairperson Clancy, seconded by Ms. Wiessen, it was unanimously VOTED: To approve the above listed grants, as noted

Our mission is for all students to be successful, engaged, lifelong learners.

Gloucester High School Library and via Zoom 
32 Leslie O. Johnson Road, Gloucester, MA 01930

Members Absent 
Paul Lundberg, Mayor 
This meeting was conducted with the School Committee in person 
and the public participating in person and remotely via Zoom. 
I. CALL TO ORDER – Chairperson Clancy called the meeting to order at 6:01 p.m. and
stated the mission of the Gloucester Public Schools.
Effective August 16, 2023, the public is welcome to attend meetings in person.
Alternatively, the public may attend through the Zoom link provided on the agenda.  The
meeting notice will reflect if the meeting is via Zoom only.  As the recent amendments to
the Open Meeting Law allow, the School Committee may continue to hold meetings
remotely.  Please note the in-person meeting will not be suspended or terminated if
technological problems interrupt the remote connection.  If you are calling in on a phone,
you can press Star 9 (*9) to request to speak.  If you are watching on a computer or
device, there is a “raise hand” button that you can tap or press to request to speak.  Please
use either of these options during Oral Communications to be recognized to speak.
